tasks.title: Count vowels
tasks.description: Implement count_vowels(text). Return how many ASCII vowels (a, e, i, o, u) occur, ignoring case.
invariants: Count only the ASCII vowels a, e, i, o, u, case-insensitively.
Never count y.
Return 0 when the text is empty or holds no vowels.

tasks.title: Normalized palindrome
tasks.description: Implement is_palindrome(text). Compare case-insensitively after removing every non-alphanumeric character.
invariants: Ignore case and every non-alphanumeric character before comparing.
An empty normalized string is a palindrome.
Return False for a non-palindrome.

tasks.title: Reverse words
tasks.description: Implement reverse_words(text). Return whitespace-separated words in reverse order with exactly one space between words.
invariants: Split on runs of whitespace and join the words with single spaces.
Return an empty string for empty or whitespace-only input.

tasks.title: Run-length encoding
tasks.description: Implement run_length_encode(text). Encode each consecutive run as its character followed by its decimal count.
invariants: Emit every character followed by its decimal run length.
Return an empty string for empty input.

tasks.title: Chunk a list
tasks.description: Implement chunk(items, size). Return a new list containing consecutive lists of at most size items.
invariants: Return [] for an empty sequence.
raise ValueError when size is smaller than 1.

tasks.title: Merge sorted lists
tasks.description: Implement merge_sorted(left, right). Merge two ascending lists into a new ascending list without dropping duplicates.
invariants: Both inputs are sorted ascending.
Values may be equal, zero or negative; preserve duplicates.
Return a new list and never mutate the inputs.

tasks.title: Rotate a list
tasks.description: Implement rotate(values, steps). Return a new list rotated right by steps; normalize steps by the list length.
invariants: Positive n rotates right and negative n rotates left.
Normalise n modulo the length.
Return [] for empty input.

tasks.title: Stable deduplication
tasks.description: Implement unique_preserve(values). Return first occurrences in input order for hashable values.
invariants: Keep the order of first occurrence.
Values may be strings or numbers.
Return [] for empty input.

tasks.title: Flatten one level
tasks.description: Implement flatten_once(groups). Concatenate one level of the supplied iterables into a new list.
invariants: Flatten exactly one level; a string contributes its characters.
Return [] for empty input.

tasks.title: Group anagrams
tasks.description: Implement group_anagrams(words). Group words by the sorted lowercase letters signature, preserving word order in each group.
invariants: Group keys are the sorted lowercase letters of each word.
Preserve input order inside each group.
Return {} for empty input.

tasks.title: Top-k frequent values
tasks.description: Implement top_k_frequent(values, k). Return up to k distinct values ordered by decreasing count, then first appearance.
invariants: Break count ties by first appearance in the input.
Return [] when k <= 0.
Return at most one entry per distinct value.

tasks.title: Balanced brackets
tasks.description: Implement balanced_brackets(text). Validate (), [] and {} nesting while ignoring all other characters.
invariants: Only (), [] and {} are tracked.
Return True for empty text.
Return False when a closer has no opener or an opener is left unclosed.

tasks.title: Camel case to snake case
tasks.description: Implement camel_to_snake(name). Convert camelCase, PascalCase and acronym runs to lowercase snake_case.
invariants: Acronym runs stay together, so HTTPRequest becomes http_request.
Existing underscores are preserved without duplicates.
Leading and trailing underscores are removed and the result is lowercase.

tasks.title: Parse a query string
tasks.description: Implement parse_query(query). Decode an ampersand-separated query into a dict mapping each key to a list of values.
invariants: Repeated keys append their values in order.
Percent-decode keys and values, treating '+' as a space.
Return {} for an empty query string.

tasks.title: Roman numeral parsing
tasks.description: Implement roman_to_int(numeral). Parse canonical Roman numerals in the range 1 through 3999.
invariants: Validate strictly and raise ValueError for malformed or non-canonical numerals such as IIII.
Support the subtractive pairs IV, IX, XL, XC, CD and CM.

tasks.title: Integer to Roman numeral
tasks.description: Implement int_to_roman(value). Convert an integer from 1 through 3999 to its canonical Roman numeral.
invariants: Support 1 to 3999 inclusive; raise ValueError outside that range.
Produce canonical numerals, using the largest symbol first.

tasks.title: GCD of many values
tasks.description: Implement gcd_many(values). Return the non-negative greatest common divisor of a non-empty integer list.
invariants: Use the absolute value of every input.
gcd_many([]) raises ValueError.
gcd_many([0, n]) returns abs(n).

tasks.title: LCM of many values
tasks.description: Implement lcm_many(values). Return the non-negative least common multiple of a non-empty integer list.
invariants: Return 0 when any input is 0.
Use absolute values, so lcm_many([-4, 6]) is 12.
lcm_many([]) raises ValueError.

tasks.title: Primality test
tasks.description: Implement is_prime(value). Return whether a non-negative integer is prime.
invariants: Return False for n < 2.
Return True only for numbers with no divisor other than 1 and themselves.
is_prime(2) is True.

tasks.title: Fibonacci number
tasks.description: Implement fibonacci(index). Return the zero-indexed Fibonacci number for a non-negative index.
invariants: Use 0-based indexing, with fibonacci(0) == 0 and fibonacci(1) == 1.
raise ValueError for negative n.

tasks.title: First binary-search match
tasks.description: Implement binary_search(values, target). Search a sorted list and return the first index containing target, or -1.
invariants: The input list is sorted ascending and may contain duplicates.
Return the index of the first occurrence of target, or -1.
Return -1 for an empty list.

tasks.title: Longest common prefix
tasks.description: Implement longest_common_prefix(words). Return the longest string prefix shared by every word.
invariants: Return '' for an empty list or when any string is empty.
Comparison is case-sensitive.

tasks.title: Levenshtein distance
tasks.description: Implement levenshtein_distance(left, right). Return the minimum insertions, deletions and substitutions needed to transform left into right.
invariants: Unit insertion, deletion and substitution each cost 1.
Return the length of the other string when one input is empty.

tasks.title: Transpose a matrix
tasks.description: Implement transpose(matrix). Return the transpose of a rectangular matrix, preserving row and column order.
invariants: Swap rows and columns.
Return [] for an empty matrix.
raise ValueError for a ragged matrix.

tasks.title: Spiral matrix traversal
tasks.description: Implement spiral_order(matrix). Return all values of a rectangular matrix in clockwise spiral order.
invariants: Walk clockwise from the top-left corner inwards.
Support non-square, single-row and single-column matrices.
Return [] for an empty matrix.

tasks.title: Matrix multiplication
tasks.description: Implement matrix_multiply(left, right). Multiply two rectangular matrices when left columns equal right rows.
invariants: raise ValueError when the inner dimensions do not match.
Support non-square, single-row and single-column matrices.

tasks.title: Merge intervals
tasks.description: Implement merge_intervals(intervals). Sort intervals by start and merge overlapping or touching closed intervals.
invariants: Intervals are closed; touching intervals merge.
Return [] for empty input.
Sort the result by start.

tasks.title: Evaluate reverse Polish notation
tasks.description: Implement evaluate_rpn(tokens). Evaluate integer operands with +, -, *, and / operators.
invariants: Tokens are strings and operands are integers.
Division truncates toward zero.
raise ValueError for malformed or under-supplied expressions.

tasks.title: Format a duration
tasks.description: Implement format_duration(seconds). Format non-negative seconds as space-separated non-zero d, h, m and s units.
invariants: Omit zero components, and format 0 as '0s'.
Emit d, h, m and s in that order, space separated.
raise ValueError for negative input.

tasks.title: Stable record sorting
tasks.description: Implement stable_sort_records(records, key). Return a new stable-sorted list using the named dictionary field.
invariants: Preserve the input order of records with equal keys.
Return [] for empty input.

tasks.title: Parse ini text
tasks.description: Implement parse_ini(text). Parse a minimal INI document into a mapping of section name to key/value strings.
invariants: Blank lines, '#' comments and ';' comments are ignored.
Keys and values are stripped of surrounding whitespace, and the key ends at the first '=' so a value may contain '='.
A repeated section header merges into the same section, with later keys overriding earlier ones.
raise ValueError when a key appears before any section header, when a line has no '=', or when a key is empty.

tasks.title: Slugify a title
tasks.description: Implement slugify(title). Build a lowercase URL slug from an arbitrary title.
invariants: Lowercase the title and drop every non-ASCII character.
Each run of characters that are not ASCII letters or digits becomes a single '-'.
Strip leading and trailing '-'.
Return '' when no ASCII letter or digit survives.

tasks.title: Parse a human readable size
tasks.description: Implement parse_size(text). Convert a size such as '10 KB' or '1.5MB' into bytes.
invariants: Accept an optional space between the number and the unit.
Units are case-insensitive and limited to B, KB, MB and GB, where each step is 1024.
The number may be an integer or a decimal, and the result is rounded to the nearest byte.
raise ValueError for empty text, a number without a unit, an unparsable number or an unknown unit.

tasks.title: Greedy word wrap
tasks.description: Implement wrap_text(text, width). Wrap text into lines of at most width characters without splitting words.
invariants: Collapse runs of whitespace and split on whitespace.
Fill each line greedily, separating words with a single space.
A word longer than width occupies a line on its own.
Return [] for empty or whitespace-only text.
raise ValueError when width is smaller than 1.

tasks.title: Parse one csv line
tasks.description: Implement parse_csv_line(line). Split a single comma separated record, honouring double quoted fields.
invariants: Split on commas that are outside double quotes.
A quoted field may contain commas and a doubled quote stands for one literal quote.
Strip surrounding whitespace from unquoted fields and keep quoted field content verbatim.
Return [''] for an empty line.
raise ValueError when a quoted field is never closed.

tasks.title: Deep merge and list merge
tasks.description: Implement deep_merge in solution.py and merge_lists in merge_utils.py. deep_merge combines nested dictionaries while merge_lists concatenates two lists without duplicates.
invariants: deep_merge merges nested dictionaries recursively and replaces lists and scalars with the override value.
Keys that only exist in the base mapping survive.
deep_merge never mutates either input.
merge_lists keeps the order of left followed by the values of right that are not already present.

tasks.title: Normalise a slash path
tasks.description: Implement normalize_path(path). Normalise a POSIX style path without touching the filesystem.
invariants: Collapse repeated '/' and drop '.' segments.
Resolve '..' against the previous segment, keeping leading '..' segments of a relative path.
Keep the leading '/' of an absolute path and never emit a trailing '/' except for the root '/'.
Return '.' for empty input.

tasks.title: Intersect closed intervals
tasks.description: Implement intersect_intervals(first, second). Intersect two sorted lists of closed integer intervals.
invariants: Both inputs are sorted by start and each interval is a two element [start, end] list with start <= end.
Return only non-empty intersections, sorted by start.
A shared single point is a valid intersection, so [1, 2] and [2, 3] intersect at [2, 2].
Return [] when either input is empty or nothing overlaps.

tasks.title: Parse a compact duration
tasks.description: Implement parse_duration(text). Convert a compact duration such as '1h30m' or '2d 3h' into whole seconds.
invariants: Units are d, h, m and s, case-insensitive, where a day is 86400 seconds.
Components may be separated by whitespace, appear in any order and each unit may appear at most once.
raise ValueError for empty text, an unknown unit, an unparsable character or a repeated unit.

tasks.title: Most frequent words
tasks.description: Implement top_words(text, k). Rank the words of a text by frequency.
invariants: A word is a run of ASCII letters or digits, compared case-insensitively.
Sort by count descending and break ties by the word ascending.
Return [] when k <= 0, and fewer than k entries when the text has fewer distinct words.

tasks.title: Compare dotted versions
tasks.description: Implement compare_versions(left, right). Compare two dotted numeric version strings.
invariants: Compare component by component as integers.
Missing trailing components count as 0, so '1.0' equals '1'.
Return -1, 0 or 1 for less than, equal to, or greater than.
raise ValueError for an empty component or a non-numeric component.

tasks.title: Safe division and percentage
tasks.description: Implement safe_divide and percentage in one module, both tolerant of a zero denominator.
invariants: safe_divide returns default when the denominator is 0, and default is 0.0 unless the caller overrides it.
percentage returns part divided by whole times 100, rounded to one decimal place.
percentage returns 0.0 when whole is 0.

tasks.title: Decode run length encoding
tasks.description: Implement decode_rle(text). Expand a run length encoded string such as 'a3b2c1'.
invariants: Each character is followed by one or more decimal digits giving its repeat count.
Return '' for empty input.
raise ValueError when a character has no count or a count is smaller than 1.

tasks.title: Convert between bases
tasks.description: Implement to_base and from_base in one module for bases 2 to 36.
invariants: Digits above 9 are the lowercase letters a to z.
to_base(0, base) is '0' and negative values keep a leading '-' in both directions.
raise ValueError when the base is outside 2 to 36, when from_base gets an invalid digit, an empty text or a digit that is too large for the base.

tasks.title: Text utilities and summarise
tasks.description: Implement summarize in solution.py, and normalize_whitespace plus word_count in text_utils.py. summarize truncates a text to a word budget and imports the helpers from text_utils.
invariants: normalize_whitespace collapses every run of whitespace to one space and strips both ends.
word_count counts the words of the normalized text and returns 0 for blank text.
summarize returns the normalized text when it has at most limit words, otherwise the first limit words followed by ' ...'.
raise ValueError when limit is smaller than 1.

tasks.title: Moving average
tasks.description: Implement moving_average(values, window). Compute the trailing average of a numeric sequence.
invariants: Return one average per full window, so the result has len(values) - window + 1 entries.
Round every average to three decimal places.
Return [] when the sequence is shorter than the window.
raise ValueError when window is smaller than 1.

tasks.title: Group records by a key
tasks.description: Implement group_by(records, key). Group a list of dictionaries by the value of one key.
invariants: Preserve the input order inside every group.
Return {} for an empty list.
raise KeyError when a record is missing the key.

tasks.title: Bigrams and jaccard similarity
tasks.description: Implement bigrams in tokens.py and jaccard in solution.py. jaccard compares the word bigram sets of two texts and imports bigrams from tokens.
invariants: bigrams lowercases the text, splits on whitespace and joins each adjacent word pair with one space.
bigrams returns [] when there are fewer than two words.
jaccard returns the size of the intersection divided by the size of the union, rounded to three decimal places.
jaccard returns 1.0 when both texts have no bigrams and 0.0 when only one of them does.

tasks.title: Rectangle areas
tasks.description: Implement total_area and overlap_area in one module. Rectangles are dictionaries with x, y, w and h.
invariants: total_area sums w * h over the rectangles and returns 0 for an empty list.
overlap_area returns the area of the axis-aligned intersection of two rectangles.
overlap_area returns 0 when the rectangles only touch or are disjoint.

tasks.title: Compress number ranges
tasks.description: Implement compress_ranges(numbers). Render sorted unique integers as comma separated ranges.
invariants: Sort the input and remove duplicates.
Collapse a run of three or more consecutive numbers into 'start-end'.
Leave runs of one or two numbers as individual values.
Return '' for empty input.
